title: geranium alnifolium
intro: Geranium alnifolium, commonly known as the Chilean geranium, is a plant species within the Geraniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to help with stress relief, anxiety, and sleep disorders. The therapeutic actions of Geranium alnifolium include its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, although more research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential uses.
